rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Agent Guard detects and prevents infinite loops in AI agent workflows using circuit breakers and pattern detection algorithms. It monitors agent execution state and intervenes when repetitive or runaway behavior is identified, preventing resource exhaustion and enabling graceful recovery. The server installs as an npm package alongside other MCP tools.
